text: dsh-input-history 是面向 DSH Web GUI 的会话输入历史插件。它在聊天输入框边界接入方向键翻查，并通过 /history 打开可搜索的悬浮面板。用户可用键盘或鼠标浏览已发送消息、将选中内容放回输入框，也可恢复原草稿；历史按会话分页读取并隔离缓存。适合需要重用本会话提示或消息的 DSH 网页用户。需要 DSH 0.1.7-rc.1 或更新版本，不需额外密钥或账号。

dsh-input-history adds message recall to the DSH Web composer. Arrow keys browse sent messages; /history opens a searchable panel for keyboard or mouse selection. Chosen text returns to the draft, and Esc restores the saved draft. History is paged per session. Requires DSH 0.1.7-rc.1 or newer.
想用方向键快速找回刚才在当前会话发送的消息。
输入框里能不能像终端一样翻看之前发过的内容？
我想从聊天历史里搜索一句话并放回草稿。
让 DSH 网页输入框支持按键浏览已发送消息。
误删了正在写的草稿，翻历史时能不能恢复它？
我希望从斜杠菜单打开一个可搜索的会话历史列表。
Let me recall an earlier message in this conversation with the arrow keys.
I want to search past messages and put one back into the web composer.
dsh-input-history 的功能「方向键翻查」：光标位于输入开头时按 ↑，或在空输入框按方向键，可逐条浏览本会话较早发送的消息；继续按 ↓ 返回较新的消息和原草稿。
dsh-input-history 的功能「搜索历史面板」：输入 /history 并从斜杠菜单选择后，会打开可搜索的历史面板；可用鼠标或方向键选择消息并按 Enter 放回输入框。
dsh-input-history 的功能「读取分页会话记录」：插件从当前会话日志分页收集用户消息，跳过空内容并折叠相邻重复文本，再供方向键与面板召回。
@loommii/dsh-input-history 提供命令 /history：Browse messages sent in this session and recall one into the composer

@loommii/dsh-input-history README · Introduction：

终端式输入历史，用 ↑/↓ 翻查本会话发过的消息。
纯客户端插件，无宿主侧改动 — /history 指令提供可搜索的历史面板。

@loommii/dsh-input-history README · ⌨️ 方向键翻查：| 操作 | 效果 |
|---|---|
| <kbd>↑</kbd> / <kbd>↓</kbd>（空输入框或光标在最前） | 开始翻查，取回最近一条已发送消息 |
| <kbd>Esc</kbd> | 还原草稿并退出翻查 |

@loommii/dsh-input-history README · 📋 `/history` 面板：| 方式 | 召回语义 |
|---|---|
| 斜杠菜单选中 `/history` | **插入模式**：消息插入到 `/history` 词元位置，前后文保留 |

面板支持**搜索过滤**、鼠标点选与 <kbd>↑</kbd>/<kbd>↓</kbd> + <kbd>Enter</kbd> 操作；<kbd>Esc</kbd> 或点击面板外取消。

> 数据读取自当前会话的完整日志（含分页），按会话严格隔离；相邻重复消息自动折叠。

@loommii/dsh-input-history README · 🚀 安装：从 NPM 安装（DSH `>=0.1.7-rc.1`，无上限）：
```
dsh plugin --profile web add @loommii/dsh-input-history@0.3.1
```

或从 GitHub 安装：

```
dsh plugin --profile web add github:loommii/dsh-input-history
```

@loommii/dsh-input-history README · DSH 版本兼容：`0.3.1` 使用 DSH 的公开 `conversation.input.for()` 输入接口，支持 DSH `0.1.7-rc.1` 及以上的所有版本（含 `0.2.x` 预发布）。

| DSH 版本 | 状态 | 说明 |
|---|---|---|
| `0.2.1-rc.2`（当前最新预发布） | ✅ 已审计，无需改代码 | 逐版本比对 `0.2.0-rc.2 → 0.2.1-rc.2` 的 7 个发布与 16 个插件 API 包，本插件使用的 10 条契约无破坏性变更 |
| `0.2.0-rc.2` | ✅ 已验证 | 0.3.1 的开发基线 |
| `0.1.7-rc.1` ~ `0.2.0-rc.1` | ✅ 兼容 | 同一套公开输入 / 会话接口 |
| `< 0.1.7-rc.1` | ❌ 不兼容 | 请改用 `0.1.2` |

`0.2.1-rc.2` 相对 `0.2.0-rc.2` 的插件面变更（均不影响本插件）：

@loommii/dsh-input-history README · DSH 版本兼容：- 插件兼容性判定改为优先读 `engines.dsh`（本插件 `>=0.1.7-rc.1` 覆盖 `0.2.1-rc.2`，实测通过）
- 移除运行时 invariant 插件及各包 `./invariant` 导出（本插件不使用）
- `conversation.session` 注入面 `bindDraftMirror` → `bindDraftPersistence`（本插件不占用该槽位）
- 命令词元 chip 化与草稿结构化持久化：`setDraft(text)` 签名不变，语义收敛为「替换为纯文本」，与历史回填行为一致

@loommii/dsh-input-history README · DSH 版本兼容：> 升级 DSH 到 `0.2.1-rc.2` 后请**整页刷新** GUI —— 新版本对跨 release 的客户端模块图做了门控，已打开的页面不会热切换到新 release 的插件。另外 npm 的 `latest` 仍指向 `0.2.0-rc.2`，`0.2.1-rc.2` 位于 `next` 标签下，升级时请显式指定版本。
> 上述兼容结论来自静态比对，建议升级后按标准回归用例确认三个边界场景：命令 chip 化后 `/history` 的词元消费、非 owner peer 下的历史读取、`0.2.0` 时代旧会话的首读。

如果你的 DSH 早于 `0.1.7-rc.1`，请安装旧兼容版本（当前仓库最后一个旧兼容 tag 为 `v0.1.2`）：

```
dsh plugin --profile web add @loommii/dsh-input-history@0.1.2
```

安装后重启 profile（`dsh web` / `dsh --profile <name>`）。

升级 / 卸载：

@loommii/dsh-input-history README · DSH 版本兼容：```
dsh plugin --profile web update @loommii/dsh-input-history
dsh plugin --profile web remove @loommii/dsh-input-history
```
@loommii/dsh-input-history README · 🏗️ 架构：本插件是纯客户端 UI：历史从宿主 `remote.session` 完整会话日志分页读取（按会话隔离缓存），回填通过公开的 `conversation.input.for(actx).setDraft()` 完成。

@loommii/dsh-input-history README · Introduction：

Terminal-style input history: press ↑/↓ to browse messages sent in the current session.
Pure client-side plugin, no host changes — the /history command opens a searchable history panel.

@loommii/dsh-input-history README · ⌨️ Arrow-key recall：| Action | Effect |
|---|---|
| <kbd>↑</kbd> / <kbd>↓</kbd> (empty composer, or caret at the very start) | Starts recall; fetches the most recent sent message |
| <kbd>Esc</kbd> | Restores the draft and exits recall |

@loommii/dsh-input-history README · 📋 `/history` panel：| Way | Recall semantics |
|---|---|
| Pick `/history` in the slash menu | **Insert mode**: the message is inserted at the `/history` token, keeping surrounding text |

The panel supports **search filtering**, mouse clicking, and <kbd>↑</kbd>/<kbd>↓</kbd> + <kbd>Enter</kbd>; <kbd>Esc</kbd> or clicking outside cancels.

> History is read from the current session's full log (paged), strictly isolated per session; adjacent duplicate messages are collapsed automatically.

@loommii/dsh-input-history README · 🚀 Install：From NPM (DSH `>=0.1.7-rc.1`, no upper bound):
```
dsh plugin --profile web add @loommii/dsh-input-history@0.3.1
```

Or from GitHub:

```
dsh plugin --profile web add github:loommii/dsh-input-history
```

@loommii/dsh-input-history README · DSH compatibility：`0.3.1` uses the public `conversation.input.for()` input API and supports DSH `0.1.7-rc.1` and every newer release (including the `0.2.x` prereleases).

@loommii/dsh-input-history README · DSH compatibility：| DSH version | Status | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `0.2.1-rc.2` (current prerelease) | ✅ Audited, no code change needed | All 7 releases between `0.2.0-rc.2` and `0.2.1-rc.2` plus 16 plugin API packages were compared; none of the 10 contracts this plugin uses changed incompatibly |
| `0.2.0-rc.2` | ✅ Verified | Development baseline of 0.3.1 |
| `0.1.7-rc.1` ~ `0.2.0-rc.1` | ✅ Compatible | Same public input / session contracts |
| `< 0.1.7-rc.1` | ❌ Incompatible | Use `0.1.2` instead |
@loommii/dsh-input-history README · DSH compatibility：Plugin-facing changes from `0.2.0-rc.2` to `0.2.1-rc.2`, none of which affect this plugin:

@loommii/dsh-input-history README · DSH compatibility：- Compatibility is now decided by `engines.dsh` when present (this package declares `>=0.1.7-rc.1`, which covers `0.2.1-rc.2`; verified)
- The runtime invariant plugins and every package's `./invariant` export were removed (unused here)
- The `conversation.session` injection face renamed `bindDraftMirror` → `bindDraftPersistence` (this plugin does not occupy that slot)
- Command tokens became atomic chips and drafts are persisted as structured snapshots: `setDraft(text)` keeps its signature, with the semantics narrowed to "replace with plain text", matching history recall

@loommii/dsh-input-history README · DSH compatibility：> After upgrading to `0.2.1-rc.2`, **reload the page**: the new release gates the client module graph per Host release, so an open page never hot-swaps to another release's plugins. Note that npm's `latest` still points at `0.2.0-rc.2` while `0.2.1-rc.2` sits under `next`; pin the version explicitly when installing.
> These conclusions come from static comparison. After upgrading, confirm the three boundary cases with the regular regression checklist: `/history` token consumption after command chips, history reads under a non-owner peer, and first reads of sessions created on `0.2.0`.

@loommii/dsh-input-history README · DSH compatibility：For a DSH version older than `0.1.7-rc.1`, install the last old-compatible tagged release (`v0.1.2`):

```
dsh plugin --profile web add @loommii/dsh-input-history@0.1.2
```

Restart the profile after installing (`dsh web` / `dsh --profile <name>`).

Upgrade / uninstall:

```
dsh plugin --profile web update @loommii/dsh-input-history
dsh plugin --profile web remove @loommii/dsh-input-history
```

@loommii/dsh-input-history README · 🏗️ Architecture：The plugin is pure client-side UI: history is paged from the host's `remote.session` full session log (cache isolated per session), and recall is written through the public `conversation.input.for(actx).setDraft()` API.
